answer: Self-signed chore lists cannot prove a key is independently operated. Admission measures a work delta: the applicant completes three paid micro-jobs at hosts drawn from a public nebula roster, unaffiliated and eight hours apart. Each host reveals a one-session cipher nonce only after the job starts, then signs the receipt if the output matches a posted spec, fee 0.44 POA. The applicant locks 22 POA for 5 epochs, refunded when all receipts verify. Peers recompute the draw and signatures. A reused host, missed window, or pre-known nonce slashes 28 percent to that host and bars the key 6 epochs.
